scene: Landing on the springy awning, you reach the elevated transit hub.
picture: A flat side-scrolling view along a rooftop transit deck. The broad-shouldered Pacific Islander man in a floral shirt, top knot, sandals, carrying his ukulele, stands left of centre. On the far left, a round brass cable pod hangs from cables. Centre right sits a sleek bullet train. On the far right docks a solar-sail junk.
shown: a hanging brass cable pod with an open hatch on the left
a sleek pink bullet train stopped with open sliding doors in the centre
a wooden junk boat with glowing emerald solar sails docked on the right
